_comment: Unattended reviews held for the owner. Both plugins must give the agent `held_text`, and the owner each notice's `text` with {approve} replaced by their approve command (/sentrook approve on Hermes, /sentrook-approve on OpenClaw). `outcomes` says what each verdict becomes on an attended and an unattended run with review at 40 and block at 80: a block, from the line or enforced, is never held. `history` gives the action and review columns history prints for held scans.
held_text: Sentrook held this tool call for the owner's approval, so it did not run. Do not retry this call in this run.

notices.name: a scheduled send at risk 47 with a suggested destination grant
notices.text:
Sentrook held a tool call on an unattended run (cron job "daily-brief", session s_0a1b2c3d4e5f); it did not run.
Tool: message. Sentrook (risk 47): Sends a message to discord:#ops-reports. Why: trigger.scheduled, send.unbound_channel. Scores: suspicion 31, consequence 42, confidence 80.
Held because it sends data to a destination outside this machine.
Approving sets a persistent grant for 30 days: destination discord:#ops-reports, so the next run passes.
To approve within 24 hours: {approve} h-1a2b3c
The held call is not run again either way.

notices.name: an enforced review of a file write, with a file grant limited to write
notices.text:

Tool: write. Sentrook (risk 52): Appends to ~/jobs/nightly/run.log. Why: destroy.overwrite.
Held because it deletes or overwrites data in a way that is hard to undo.
Approving sets a persistent grant for 30 days: file ~/jobs/nightly/*.log (allows write), so the next run passes.
To approve within 24 hours: {approve} h-00ff00
The held call is not run again either way.
